title: 2022 CODATA: standard-state pressure is 100 000
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks standard-state pressure as exact: 100 000 Pa.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks standard-state pressure as exact: 100 000 Pa. No uncertainty is printed on that row. The standard-state pressure in this listing is a conventional exact pressure of 100 000 pascals. It is not the standard atmosphere of 101 325 pascals.
